# Lab 5.5: Table-Valued Functions

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a table-valued function that works like a view with parameters, and query it in the FROM clause.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create the TVF.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE FUNCTION lab05.orders_for_country(country_name STRING, since DATE)
AS
SELECT o.order_id, o.status, o.created_at, u.city
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` o
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.country = country_name AND DATE(o.created_at) &gt;= since;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Query it like a table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM lab05.orders_for_country('India', '2025-01-01')
GROUP BY city ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Join a TVF to other tables.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT t.status, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM lab05.orders_for_country('Japan', '2024-01-01') t
GROUP BY t.status;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[CLI] Call it from bq with parameters.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --parameter=c:STRING:Brasil \
'SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM lab05.orders_for_country(@c, DATE "2025-01-01")'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] See the TVF in Explorer.** It appears under **Routines** with type **Table function**, and its return columns are listed.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| TVF | A view that takes arguments |
| Usage | In `FROM`, can be joined |
| Parameters | Work with `bq --parameter` |
| Type | `TABLE_VALUED_FUNCTION` |
